title: Classification and counting of two-bent decompositions
summary: Characterize the Boolean functions that are sums of two bent functions and count every such decomposition.

formal_statement.body: For every Boolean function $p:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ with even $n$, determine whether there exist bent functions $f,h$ such that $p=f+h$. Give necessary and sufficient conditions for existence and, whenever $p$ is representable, determine the exact number of such bent decompositions under an explicitly stated counting convention.

scope.domain: Boolean functions and additive decompositions into bent functions
assumptions: Addition of Boolean functions is over F_2
scope.unresolved_remainder: Later work exactly counts a translation-constrained affine subproblem. A necessary-and-sufficient representability characterization and a source-neutral decomposition count for every representable Boolean function remain unknown.

provenance.note: The 2022 TIT paper quotes Tokareva's two-part question and identifies its own contribution as partial.

progress.summary: Tokareva asks for both an exact representability criterion and the number of two-bent decompositions.
The TIT source restates the full problem and obtains decompositions under a strict derivative condition.
A later paper exactly counts decompositions of a nonconstant affine function into two bent translates in a common direction, a strict structural subproblem of the general question.
